scan_order_mapping_rule: At sequence index seq, activate heat set set_body_heat_{track:02d}, where track = scan_order[seq].
load_lifecycle_rule: Each scan step creates one BodyHeatFlux load on the target track set; the load is deactivated in the following cooling step and remains inactive through final cooling.
user_confirmation_note: Use JNL-extracted BodyHeatFlux magnitude and step durations for N12_A01 pilot only. Full 60 generation remains blocked until the pilot INP is inspected.
